title: Green Hydrogen

anim.title: Hydrogen has colours
items: Blue: gas, with the carbon captured
Green: made from water, with clean power

segments.say: Hydrogen is invisible, but people give it colours. Grey, made from natural gas. Blue, with the carbon caught. And green.
Green hydrogen is made by passing electricity from the sun or the wind through water, in a machine called an electrolyser. Out come hydrogen and oxygen, and no carbon dioxide.
So it needs lots of cheap clean power, like this floating solar farm on a reservoir in Madhya Pradesh.
Where is it useful? In places electricity alone can't easily reach: fertiliser, refineries, steel making, and heavy transport.

anim.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission
items: Target: 5 million tonnes a year by 2030

segments.say: India's National Green Hydrogen Mission, approved in January twenty twenty-three, aims to make five million tonnes a year by twenty thirty.
The hard part is cost. Green hydrogen still costs more than grey, so the mission backs cheaper electrolysers and clean power.
For GS Three: green hydrogen is hydrogen from water and clean power, and it matters most for industries that are hard to clean up.
